agent_priors_used: General prior (not SPIDER evidence): autonomous research agents show strong path dependence and local-attractor behavior; a lane that just advanced a claim tends to continue it even when the next result cannot change a decision.

General prior (not SPIDER evidence): measurement-instrument construction is expensive and failure-prone, so a shared prerequisite that repeatedly sinks packets across lanes should be repaired once rather than rediscovered per lane.

General prior (not SPIDER evidence): the marginal information of another estimator/threshold refinement on an exhausted evidence base is low; a materially new observable or dataset is usually required for a step change.
General prior (not SPIDER evidence): pre-freeze attainability and power certificates prevent spending an execute budget on experiments whose accept region is arithmetically unreachable.
General prior (not SPIDER evidence): idle capacity has opportunity cost; an idle lane should be reactivated when a well-specified decision-relevant question exists and parked explicitly otherwise.

allocation.comparative_reasoning: Alternatives considered: (a) PIVOT to the external four-arm C-LLM-INHERIT benchmark - blocked on Intel's credential-free endpoint provisioning (frozen, in progress at EXP-INTEL-37982024058) and, independently, on this same task bank lacking dynamic range, so it cannot be dispatched productively now; (b) PIVOT to C-PRODUCT-ECON end-to-end amortized economics - this is the same object as C-RESIDUAL-NOVELTY at the current stage and would duplicate it; (c) PIVOT to C-DELTA-REPAIR or C-SEMANTIC-RESOLVE - both downstream of a trustworthy freshness/applicability decision and without a product use case; (d) rebuild kernel liveness - already done. CONTINUE C-RESIDUAL-NOVELTY with a mandatory pre-freeze certificate is the single most decision-bearing product step and unblocks the external benchmark as a by-product.
allocation.question: On a credential-free task bank whose correct action is NOT fully determined by the task specification (multi-step discovery, server-side state that must be read before acting, or parameters not derivable by direct URL construction), can a PRE-FREEZE, arithmetically checkable dynamic-range certificate be produced BEFORE freeze.json exists - B-COLD-RE-DERIVE and B-RETRIEVAL-SHAPED success_rate < 0.95 at novelty >= 0.5 on at least one task family, with matched correctness >= 0.80 for all arms - so that cost per SUCCESSFUL task on an honest metric that includes retrieval_calls plus http_requests, verification_calls, repair_attempts and latency_ms can be compared between the live-kernel treatment arm (the shipped parameterize->resolve->execute path established at EXP-PRODUCT-37973256064) and cold re-derivation, a retrieval-shaped comparator, and an emptied-registry null, and does the treatment advantage increase monotonically with residual novelty (Spearman rho > 0.5, permutation p < 0.05) rather than with full task length? The treatment carrier must be either restored to or explicitly bound by git blob hash (audited blob b15ed848 / sha256 718efa6a167c2fdc483a8fbaaf1a05ce018dcb1c52808414b2a6a76d788bfb72). If the certificate is unsatisfiable on every credential-free deterministic substrate tested, record that bounded substrate-class negative and DO NOT freeze.
allocation.rationale: This is the closest thing in the program to SPIDER's distinctive thesis (pay for novelty, not for the whole task), and it is now upstream-enabled: product proved the kernel treatment path is live and causally attributable on a real credential-free substrate (EXP-PRODUCT-37973256064). The immediately preceding attempt (EXP-PRODUCT-37982016598) was correctly aborted at a pre-freeze dynamic-range gate that was already false, because cold re-derivation and retrieval sat at the correctness ceiling. The bottleneck is therefore the task bank itself, and the mandate must force the dynamic-range certificate to be demonstrated arithmetically before freeze rather than asserted. The same task bank is the enabling artifact for the later external-agent four-arm benchmark, so this work is shared, not duplicated.

director_mandate.portfolio_assessment: Cycle 37988756989. 429 canonical experiments; 3 lanes carry frozen transactions that must be completed under their frozen design (frontier: C-RESIDUAL-NOVELTY site-native discovery vs link-following BFS; intel: C-LLM-INHERIT credential-free model provisioning / re-scope; runtime: C-MEAS-VALID outside-surface intervention-oracle discrimination plus the within-50ms write-revert blind-spot probe), and 3 are idle (graph, physics, product). This window cleared two central prerequisites: product established that the shipped kernel's parameterize->resolve->execute path is live, causally attributable and honestly accounted on a real credential-free substrate (EXP-PRODUCT-37973256064), and graph advanced C-FRESHNESS HYPOTHESIS->EXPERIMENTAL after confirming an extraction defect and session-scoped value rotation on four pinned anchors (EXP-GRAPH-37978902447). The central missing proof is still the integrated causal chain (observation -> parameterized mechanism -> executable binding in the shipped kernel -> applicability/freshness decision -> real external agent action -> lower cost per successful task). The sharpest observed bottleneck is that the credential-free task bank has no dynamic range: both C-RESIDUAL-NOVELTY (EXP-PRODUCT-37982016598) and the earlier C-PARAM-INHERIT margin failed because cold re-derivation and the retrieval-shaped comparator sit at the correctness ceiling, so any economics comparison is degenerate before it starts. Product must therefore build a task bank whose correct action is NOT determined by the task specification and certify dynamic range arithmetically BEFORE freeze. For graph, the freshness/applicability guard is the decision-bearing piece of that chain: the last packet left PART II (the incumbent value-blind false-accept differential) degenerate because all D1V trials came from a single anchor, so a multi-anchor D1V population is required to decide whether a value-aware channel is needed in the product freshness guard. Physics produced a clean, audited negative on value-level action-gating predictability (EXP-PHYSICS-37973239386) and is off the critical path; the one materially new observable it can still test without a new dataset is access-barrier onset/recovery dynamics, which carries product leverage (request scheduling) but also the program's documented attainability failure mode, so I reopen it only under a mandatory pre-freeze attainability/power certificate. Expected marginal value is concentrated on (1) the policy/task-bank dynamic-range prerequisite in Product and (2) the multi-anchor freshness-guard discrimination in Graph; the already-frozen transactions are preserved unchanged.
